sources.snippet: Merillat Classic rated B Quality B Value at Price Level 3 with plywood upgrade assumed. MLKD rating specifically says Merillat Classic Plywood upgrade. Standard build without upgrade does NOT achieve B rating. Points out Fabuwood at PL2 receives A/A at lower cost with standard plywood and dovetail drawers.
sources.classification_reason: Primary independent professional rating source. Critical distinction that rating assumes plywood upgrade.

sources.snippet: End panels sides 3/8 inch engineered wood 48-lb density. Bottom panel 1/2 inch engineered wood with dado and adhesive joint. Back panel wall 3/8 inch base 1/4 inch running to floor. Face frame 3/4 inch solid hardwood. Shelves 3/4 inch engineered wood adjustable. Plywood end panels and all-plywood construction available as upgrade options.
sources.classification_reason: Manufacturer specification data. 3/8 inch sides are critical spec — notably thin vs 1/2 inch industry standard.

sources.source_name: Merillat Classic Product Page — Drawer Joinery
sources.snippet: All corners of the drawer core use rabbet joinery secured with adhesive and staples. This is the standard tier. Dovetail drawers are a Deluxe upgrade not standard. Deluxe tier provides 5/8 inch solid hardwood dovetail with plywood bottom. Standard tier uses engineered wood drawer with rabbet joint.
sources.classification_reason: Manufacturer specification confirming standard drawer joinery is rabbet plus staples, NOT dovetail. Critical scoring distinction.

sources.snippet: Standard tier 3/4-extension side-mount dual-captive roller drawer guide system 75 lb load capacity. NOT ball-bearing NOT full-extension. Commodity roller-wheel system same class as entry-level builder and RTA. Deluxe tier full-extension concealed undermount with SoftAction+ soft-close. Brand not disclosed for either tier. No cycle life published.
sources.classification_reason: Manufacturer specification confirming standard slide is commodity roller, not premium undermount. Significant hardware gap vs competitors.

sources.source_name: Fine Homebuilding Forum — Merillat Installer Feedback
sources.snippet: Contractor 25 plus years switched away from Merillat after repeated glazed finish inconsistency, doors arriving warped or unfinished, poor QC on cherry edge routing, customer service refusing further replacements. Separate installer described Classic as step above Mills Pride noting 3/8 sides hot-melt glue not covering all joints crowns in front rails cabinets slightly out of square finish appearing soft on certain colors. Merillat solid but just a basic lower to middle end cabinet lower grade hinges drawer slides.
sources.classification_reason: Multiple professional installers with long-tenure experience providing detailed construction and QC assessments.

sources.snippet: All Classic cabinets use proprietary SoftAction concealed hinges nickel-plated 6-way adjustable with integrated soft-close. Merillat-branded no third-party manufacturer Blum Grass Salice identified. Cycle life not publicly rated. Limited lifetime warranty on hinges.
sources.classification_reason: Manufacturer specification confirming proprietary unbranded hardware. Absence of third-party brand name and cycle life data is a verifiable finding.

sources.snippet: Merillat and Cabinetworks Group resigned from KCMA October 2022 over anti-circumvention dispute. No current KCMA A161.1 certification found for Merillat Classic specifically. Unlike American Woodmark which re-certified for some products, no 2025 or 2026 KCMA certificate found for Merillat.
sources.classification_reason: KCMA certification absence verified through directory check. Affects scoring per methodology.

sources.snippet: Unupgraded Classic has 3/8 particle board sides and plastic corner braces. Called unupgraded KraftMaid a giant step up. Separate 2015 homeowner post documented door warping on painted doors replacements arriving with same problem laminate edge chipping on shelves inconsistent white color matching missing door soft-close on base cabinets.
sources.classification_reason: Professional and consumer field reports identifying specific construction and QC issues.

sources.source_name: Kitchen Dealer Comparison — Merillat vs KraftMaid 2026
sources.snippet: Classic thinner box material noticeable compared to KraftMaid but adequate for normal residential use. Gap widens in heavy-use areas base cabinets near stove pot-and-pan drawers upper cabinets holding heavy items. FastTrack 2-week lead time cited as genuine competitive advantage for production builders.
sources.classification_reason: Trade comparison analysis with specific construction gap assessment and competitive positioning.

sources.snippet: 25-year limited warranty for cabinets purchased on or after January 5 2009. NOT transferable. Excludes moisture damage, UV aging, color variation, installation damage, natural joint movement hairline cracks. No labor coverage for removal or reinstallation. Replacements may not match original finish if discontinued.
sources.classification_reason: Warranty terms for buyer report context. Moisture exclusion significant given particleboard construction.

sources.snippet: Standard 3/4-extension side-mount roller system documented as primary long-term failure point. Plastic components in roller-wheel track brackets fail over time. Merillat discontinued individual replacement brackets requiring purchase of full new track system.
sources.classification_reason: Documented hardware failure pattern with specific component identification and repair/replacement limitation.

sources.snippet: 66 homeowner and contractor reviews with mixed results. One negative review noted falling apart construction is subpar with particle board framework. Mixed satisfaction across consumer base.
sources.classification_reason: Consumer review aggregation with moderate sample size showing mixed quality reception.

sources.snippet: Defective cabinets wrong doors and colors delivered zero quality control. Consistent with large-volume builder-channel QC complaints common to MasterBrand and Cabinetworks production lines.
sources.classification_reason: Consumer complaint platform data corroborating QC consistency issues identified by professionals.

sources.source_name: Platinum Equity / Cabinetworks Corporate Risk Data
sources.snippet: Same PE ownership and financial pressures as KraftMaid. Platinum Equity since 2021. EBITDA compression failed refinancing three plant closures 2024. Shared corporate infrastructure with KraftMaid.
sources.classification_reason: Corporate risk data for outlook assessment. Same parent company risk profile as KraftMaid.

bottom_line: MasterBrand builder-grade line. Particleboard box. Generic drawer slides (35K cycles, 75 lb). Blum hinges but lower spec. Catalyzed lacquer finish. KCMA certified (positive). No soft-close standard. Platform shares with KraftMaid/Diamond but gets lowest-tier components.
platform_disclosure: MasterBrand Cabinets (Fortune Brands): KraftMaid, Diamond, Merillat, Decora, Omega, Aristockraft, Homecrest share factories. Higher lines get better hardware and materials from same plants.
outlook_rationale: MasterBrand builder-grade line. Particleboard box. Generic drawer slides (35K cycles, 75 lb). Blum hinges but lower spec. Catalyzed lacquer finish. KCMA certified (positive). No soft-close standard. Platform shares with KraftMaid/Diamond but gets lowest-tier components.
